highlights: Daily guides went live from 2 to 5 October: wholesale kurtis that sell, kidswear for school reopening, pricing clothes for a healthy margin, and dead stock prevention and clearance.
The pricing and dead stock guides cover everyday money problems for small-town shop owners and point readers to the free margin calculator and low-MOQ collections.
The kurtis and kidswear guides target seasonal buying searches and link to the Ethnic & Occasion and Kidswear wholesale pages.
Social drafts were prepared every day for WhatsApp, Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook, with LinkedIn alternating between retailers and brands.
Outreach started with 5 Gmail drafts to independent ethnic and saree retailers in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns, waiting for review before sending.
